---
title: "Gallery"
toc: false
comments: false
page-layout: full
# Masonry photo gallery (andrewheiss/quarto-static-photo-gallery). The
# extension runs `uv run` on each render to make thumbnails in img/thumbs/
# (gitignored) and read captions from img/album.yml.
extensions:
  photo-gallery:
    album-files: img
    layout: masonry
    columns: 3
    gap: 8
    thumbnail-height: 600
    show-exif: false
    date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
---

{{< photo-gallery >}}
